name: The Dead City
source:
It’s been 5 years since Hugues Viane’s wife died, and he’s taken refuge with his grief in the Dead City, spending days walking along its lonely streets and gloomy canals, until one day he encounters his wife’s double- changing everything he’s expected.

Adapted from the Symbolist novel Bruges-la-Morte by Georges Rodenbach.
